entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Prabhakar Pal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shekhar Kumar Yadav,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as the learned AGA and perused the material available on record.

2. Present Anticipatory Bail Application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in Case Crime No. 208 of 2014, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC and Section 3/7 of EC Act, P.S. Patiyali, District Etah, during the pendency of trial.

3. Perusal of record discloses that in the matter charge sheet has been submitted way back on 30.08.2014 and there is no explanation as to why the present application has been filed after long Rambaran Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167354475/
1 time.

entities.text: Rambaran Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Moreover, NBW has also been issued against the applicant.

4. Learned AGA appearing for the State submitted that applicant is not cooperating with the trial,
therefore, not only non bailable warrant was issued but by now proceedings under Section 82/83 Cr.P.C. might have also been initiated against applicant, therefore, no case for anticipatory bail is made out.
5. Number of arguments were advanced by learned counsel for the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the accusation against the applicant by the informant.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the applicants and upon perusal of material brought on record as well as complicity of accused and also judgment of the Apex Court in the case of Prem Shankar Prasad vs. State of Bihar, 2021 SCC OnLine SC 955, in which the Hon'ble Apex Court has opined that if coercive action has been initiated against the accused/applicant, then the anticipatory bail is not maintainable.

entities.text: Prem Shankar Prasad vs. State of Bihar, 2021 SCC OnLine SC 955
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. Upon perusal of material brought on record as well as complicity of accused, I do not find it a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail.
8. Accordingly, this application has no force and is accordingly dismissed.
However, applicant is directed to surrender before Trial Court and to move an application for bail and in case the same is filed same shall be decided in accordance with law.
